title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Corrected Claim Reference: Missing-Information Denials
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — corrected claims for missing-information denials (CO-16).** When a payer denies part of a claim for missing information, Halverson Clinical Laboratories answers the denial with a corrected claim. A missing-information correction answers the claim's most recent missing-information denial and carries the denied amount being resubmitted, as fixed by the company's rule for missing-information corrections. The corrected claim recorded on the claim history is the observable result.

## Capability

`file_information_correction_a0c86b6b` records one corrected-claim resubmission, dated today, on the claim ledger of the coverage the claim was filed with, under the original claim number, linked to the missing-information denial line it answers and carrying the amount put back in front of the plan. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes. On success the resubmission appears in the coverage's claim history with the reason *corrected claim*.

## Invocation

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `file_information_correction_a0c86b6b` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | Reference number of the coverage the corrected claim goes to, as returned by the coverage lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | Laboratory claim number of the claim being corrected | 'C' followed by 10 digits, exactly as shown on the claim history |
| `order_id` | Reference number of the order the corrected claim bills, as shown on the claim history line | Id |
| `source_claim_event_id` | Reference number of the missing-information denial line the corrected claim answers, as returned by the claim-history lookup | Id |
| `rebill_amount` | Amount the corrected claim puts back in front of the plan | USD with 2 decimal places, a non-negative number rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A text receipt carrying `claim_event_id` (reference number of the new resubmission), `event_type` with the value `coverage_claim_resubmitted` and `resubmission_reason` with the value `corrected_claim` (together confirming a corrected claim was recorded), `claim_number` (the claim corrected), `amount` (the amount put back, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today's date as YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the corrected claim was recorded.

## Reference notes

- The corrected claim keeps the original claim number; it is not a new claim.
- `rebill_amount` may be zero but never negative.
